description: Which target platforms each library supports, and what it needs to run headless.

targets.description: Automap platform ids the library supports.

headless.description: The environment `verify` sets to run the library without a display, as Automap's CI runs it: one VAR=value setting, or one per platform id where they differ (an empty string sets nothing). The build is the same as for windowed runs.

gpu_backends.description: The GPU API the library uses on each platform id.

web.description: Whether the library builds for the web.

system_dependencies.description: System packages a platform's build needs that vcpkg doesn't supply, per platform id.

rules.text: Every library in the composition lists the evidence's platform among its targets, and the composition builds and completes a probe run on it. The CLI also refuses to resolve a manifest naming a platform some library doesn't list.

seeded_violation.description: Add to the manifest a platform one library doesn't list.
